text:
Marta: Heads-up
ltor asked for a joint syndication push: catalog feature, short benchmark post, and a 30har technical highlight for their newsletter. We need a lean ops checklist. Who can pick owners?

Ken: I can own the catalog listing + metadata. Need logos, 1 hero image (1200x600), two-line blurb, and a 60s demo link. Altor wants the listing live the week of June 29.

Noah (Altor): We'll provide logos and can amplify via our partner digest. We can also host the 60s clip if you supply a quick script.

Priya: I'll take the benchmark post. Plan: small methodology, two charts (latency & cost delta for caching vs no caching), and a short takeaway. Need perf runs and sample prompt set by Tue.

Sam: I'll handle lead routing and AE one-pager (top objections + quick rebuttals). Routing should tag source=altor_catalog and set utm_campaign.

dev-ops-bot: Posting the marketplace readiness checklist. Required: assets, 60s video, legal signoff, UTM tags. Template in #ops-templates.

Design: We can do the hero + social cards. Need final headline + 3 bullets by Fri. Also can edit the 60s clip.

Marta: Quick UTM snippet for ops to implement:

```
source=partner_catalog
partner=altor
campaign=altor_syndicate_jun2026
utm_source=altor_catalog&utm_medium=partner&utm_campaign=altor_syndicate_jun2026
sfdc_queue=Partners_Altor
```

Ken: Timeline check assets due by Jun 18, draft benchmark by Jun 21, listing live Jun 29. Any conflicts?

Priya: I'll run perf sweep today and post numbers tomorrow. If numbers shift, we'll annotate methodology.

Sam: I'll draft the AE one-pager template and post for review. It will include fields: lead_source, partner, interest_area, urgency, contact, demo_link.

Marta: Action owners recap:
- Ken: catalog listing + metadata (owner)
- Priya: benchmark post + methodology (owner)
- Sam: lead routing + AE one-pager (owner)
- Design: hero + social + video edit (owner)
- Noah (Altor): partner assets + newsletter amp (partner)

Marta: Post blockers here. If none, I'll spin up a timeline doc and ping Legal for quote approvals. :sparkles:
